original_reference: Sub-canopy LiDAR waveform decomposition / Change Detection
transfer_hypothesis: Persistent high-contrast or geometric response may improve candidate-area weighting when combined with other evidence.
why_promising: These methods effectively penetrate canopy and detect unnatural geometries.
assumptions: Wreckage differs spectrally or geometrically from surroundings
expected_signal: Anomalous multi-return geometries or persistent high-contrast pixels
experiment_design: Compare known sites to empty adjacent zones
limitations: Highly confounded by dense natural rock formations or active human zones
